status: one-seed context-control diagnostic; not a headline result

comparison.goal_channel: ordinary goal tokens in the full causal prompt
single-vector Z with late-layer additive access
four continuous prefix vectors projected from Z

interpretation: The direct text-prefix control underperforms both the best additive late-layer Z condition and the four-token continuous-prefix condition at the matched one-seed pilot scale.

This does not establish general superiority of latent conditioning: the direct control processes a longer held-out prompt containing distractors, while the latent variants separately encode the goal and generate from a shorter content prompt.

The result supports continuing the conditioning-mechanism diagnostics and motivates the planned direct-goal exposure curve, which will test whether direct symbolic access causes bypass when introduced into the same Z-conditioned model.
Prompt routing is explicitly controlled by generation_prompt_only and covered by a regression test so direct and Z-only conditions cannot silently share the wrong input channel.
